mapper.select: SELECT rs.repayment_schedule_id, rs.loan_account_id, rs.installment_no, rs.repayment_schedule_status_id, rs.scheduled_date, lp.interest_type_id, lp.repayment_method_id, lc.contract_base_rate, lc.contract_additional_rate, lc.contract_principal, lc.total_installments, la.last_confirmed_installment_no, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(prior.scheduled_principal), 0) FROM repayment_schedule prior WHERE prior.loan_account_id = rs.loan_account_id AND prior.installment_no < rs.installment_no) AS prior_scheduled_principal_sum FROM repayment_schedule rs JOIN loan_account la ON la.loan_account_id = rs.loan_account_id JOIN loan_contract lc ON lc.loan_contract_id = la.loan_contract_id JOIN loan_product lp ON lp.loan_product_id = lc.loan_product_id WHERE rs.repayment_schedule_id = #{repaymentScheduleId}

SELECT repayment_schedule_id, loan_account_id, repayment_schedule_status_id, scheduled_date, confirmed_at, scheduled_principal, scheduled_interest, paid_principal, paid_interest FROM repayment_schedule WHERE loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} AND repayment_schedule_status_id IN (#{due}, #{overdue}) ORDER BY installment_no

SELECT repayment_schedule_id, loan_account_id, repayment_schedule_status_id, scheduled_date, confirmed_at, scheduled_principal, scheduled_interest, paid_principal, paid_interest FROM repayment_schedule WHERE loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} AND repayment_schedule_status_id IN (#{scheduled}, #{due}, #{overdue}) ORDER BY installment_no
mapper.insert:

mapper.update: UPDATE repayment_schedule SET scheduled_principal = #{amount.principal}, scheduled_interest = #{amount.interest}, applied_base_rate = #{rate.baseRate}, applied_additional_rate = #{rate.additionalRate}, confirmed_at = NOW() WHERE repayment_schedule_id = #{repaymentScheduleId}
